newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,103 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,103 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits fell by 751.1 million Swiss francs to 3.103 billion in the reporting period ended April 10.
Statement of April 11 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window rose by 23.2 million francs to 24.2 million in the reporting period.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 598.8 million francs to 1,164.0 million.
An SNB spokesman said that sight deposits were lower than normal during the latest reporting period, reflecting a low demand for liquidity by banks. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
